svg.title: Effect of spatial reference phase on element-wise intensity measurements
svg.desc: Two simultaneous elements of a holographic aperture receive the same illustrative complex envelope and equal reference magnitudes. The reference phases are fixed at zero and ninety degrees. Squared RF traces use a common amplitude scale. Each horizontal bar is the time average of that trace over one subslot. The two selected means determine the two outlined heatmap cells in the first payload symbol. Carrier cycles are reduced for visibility. Intensities are in common arbitrary units.
